_doc: DATUM gateway builds the site recommends, best first. This file is the only place the order lives: server.py orders the 'Which DATUM gateway' list (index.html items with data-gw=ID; their copy is connect.<i18n> in static/i18n/*.js), writes the llms.txt section, and serves the file at /api/gateway-builds for the MCP. reco marks the first entry Recommended. summary is the English line llms.txt and the MCP use. Order and wording set by Mike 2026-10-09: CONVOY first, FlyTheElephant second, Ratum third; iohzrd's C datum_gateway removed (unchanged since 5 Sep 2026, its fixes are in CONVOY); descriptions short, with nothing negative about a build. Evidence: ~/xbt-rnd/xbt-133/results (CONVOY 971af86 vs b9ea7dc) and ~/xbt-rnd/gw-review/results (FTE 280cf54, iohzrd 76d748e), same harness; XBT-084 (C builds, late split) and XBT-082 (Ratum).

gateways.name: CONVOY datum_gateway
gateways.summary: The reference BLAKE2b DATUM gateway and the most actively maintained (master 971af86, 9 Oct 2026). Every miner gets the whole split, so a found block pays the whole window: on regtest against our Prime, blocks found by an Antminer A3 and by a generic miner each paid all 60 miners in the window.

gateways.name: FlyTheElephant datum_gateway
gateways.summary: CONVOY's code plus FlyTheElephant's own work (master 280cf54, 7 Oct 2026). Every miner gets the whole split, so a found block pays the whole window: same regtest result, all 60 miners paid. Setup guide at /flytheelephant.

gateways.name: Ratum (ratum-gateway)
gateways.summary: iohzrd's Rust gateway: one binary for Linux, macOS and Windows, reading the C gateway's config file. Every found block in our regtest runs was booked split with every payee paid. Set mining.pool_address to your own address. Setup guide at /ratum.
